about: Pins for sources/veda.js, taken 2026-09-26. archive: the sha1 archive.org lists (in the item’s /metadata) for each file the build reads, checked against the cached copy. sayana: the sa.wikisource revision id and the sha1 of its wikitext for each hymn page that carries {{सायणभाष्यम्}} (1,019 pages: every hymn but the Valakhilya, plus 8.56 and 8.58), keyed by the standard mandala.hymn.
